name: Electrical and Computer Engineering, Ph.D. / Combined Master's & Doctoral
department: College of Engineering — Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Fall 2027 International Admissions Guide has not yet been published by SNU Office of Admissions (Spring 2027 international online application ran July 6-9, 2026).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Central SNU Graduate Admissions Guide and the department's English pages do not state whether pre-application supervisor contact is required.

funding.value: Competitive funding via BK21 Four SNU Global EDGE Fellowship for incoming international PhD students (full tuition + KRW 1,800,000/month), ECE TA/RA and Tuition Exemption Scholarships, plus university-wide GSFS/SPF fellowships.
funding.quote: We are pleased to announce that applications for the SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program for Fall 2026 are now open. | 3. Scholarship Benefits | - Full tuition coverage | - Monthly stipend of KRW 1,800,000

also.quote: Various scholarship and student loan programs are available for both domestic and international students with outstanding academic standing or financial need. | - Tuition and Admission Fee Exemption Scholarship | - Teaching, Research Assistant Scholarship

entry_route.value: Accepts both bachelor's holders (Combined Master's & Doctoral course) and master's holders (Doctoral program).
entry_route.quote: 1) Master’s / Combined Master’s & Doctoral Programs: a bachelor’s degree or higher | Combined Master’s and Doctoral Course is available to applicants who wish to obtain a Ph.D. degree without a master’s degree. Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or higher and should apply for the Combined Master’s and Doctoral Course. | Electrical and Computer Engineering ◯ ◯ ◯

notes: 96 of 135 ECE graduate courses provide online lecture notes; research groups span semiconductors, photonics, communications, power systems, control/robotics, and computer systems.
